relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: BCP dose-dependently alleviated STZ-induced mechanical allodynia, with the 27 µg dose producing the most pronounced effect

relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: The anti-allodynic effects of BCP were mediated through CB<sub>2</sub> receptor activation, confirmed by reversal with the CB<sub>2</sub> antagonist AM630

relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily i.pl. administration of BCP (27 µg for 21 days) significantly reduced these elevated cytokine levels (p < 0.01), demonstrating its potent anti-inflammatory effects.

relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic topical BCP administration (27 µg for 21 days) significantly reduced MDA levels while restoring SOD and CAT activities

relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: BCP is a known peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-γ) agonist, contributing to anti-inflammatory and metabolic regulation [36]

relationships.subject: β-Caryophyllene
relationships.evidence_quote: it activates the Nrf2/HO-1 antioxidant pathway, enhancing cellular resilience against oxidative stress [37]

key_findings: Intraplantar BCP dose-dependently relieved STZ-induced mechanical allodynia via CB2 (reversed by AM630, not AM251).
BCP reduced TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6 and MDA and restored SOD/CAT in a CB2-dependent manner.
